scripts.build: npm run build --workspaces && mkdir -p bin && go build -o bin/refbox ./cmd/refbox && go build -o bin/refbox-broker ./cmd/refbox-broker
scripts.test: npm test --workspace apps/runtime && npm run test:services && node apps/web/test/api-check.mjs && go test -race ./...
scripts.test:services: node --test apps/services/test/in-process.test.mjs && node --test --test-name-pattern='real Pi Durable|verifier cannot reuse' apps/services/test/services.test.mjs
